title: [BFC 26-052] - Report regarding the agreement with Tablet Command, Inc., for Incident
text:
[4. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
[BFC 26-052] - Report regarding the agreement with Tablet Command, Inc., for Incident
  Response and Management Software.
